first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The dark blue open-wheel race car carrying the cockpit viewpoint, with an open cockpit, black front wheels, and a protective frame with a central pillar visible.

entities.name: gray paved racetrack
entities.identification: The broad gray road surface ahead of Vehicle A, curving around the grass on the left.

entities.name: light blue sky
entities.identification: The large expanses of light blue sky within the openings on both sides of the protective frame, paler near the horizon.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The driver operating the steering wheel inside Vehicle A; only the hands wearing dark blue gloves and parts of the forearms are visible.

entities.name: multi-button steering wheel
entities.identification: A black, irregularly shaped steering wheel with colored buttons, circular knobs, and a silver-gray concave curved edge.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: The low open-wheel race car ahead of Vehicle A, with light-colored body areas and dark wheel and rear contours.

entities.name: red-and-white curb
entities.identification: The narrow, segmented red-and-white paved strip at the edge of the racetrack; in the later section, only light-colored and pale red portions are exposed.

entities.name: grass beside the racetrack
entities.identification: The green grass strips beyond the road surface, the grass on the inside of the bend, and the distant grassy slope.

entities.name: trees beside the racetrack
entities.identification: Clusters of green trees around the outside of the road and near the grandstands.

entities.name: racetrack safety barrier
entities.identification: The low wall outside the road; a light-colored wall surface and a short orange-red section are visible on the right in the early and middle sections.

entities.name: racetrack metal mesh fence
entities.identification: The mesh fence supported by vertical posts around the racetrack, in front of the grandstands.

entities.name: tiered grandstand
entities.identification: The groups of tiered seating outside the racetrack, including grandstands with broad light-colored roofs and roofless grandstands.

entities.name: racetrack sign
entities.identification: The green rectangular advertising panels and other distant rectangular signs around the road.

entities.name: distant hills
entities.identification: The light gray-blue, gently undulating ridge near the horizon on the left.

entities.name: spectators beside the racetrack
entities.identification: The dense distant crowd in the grandstand seats, maintained as a group entity.

entities.name: cockpit instrument display
entities.identification: The fixed black rectangular digital display behind the steering wheel, containing light-colored characters and a colored strip along the bottom.
